text: Toronto Public Health will present on Adverse Childhood Experiences, their lifelong health impacts, and their disproportionate effects on Indigenous, Black, racialized, 2SLGBTQIA+, low-income and other equity-denied communities. The item will highlight protective factors, the Ontario Early Adversity and Resilience Framework, and Toronto Public Health's current and emerging interventions to strengthen child, family and community resilience.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
